description: This file defines the LocalizedContentItemsQueryProvider class, which implements IContentItemsQueryProvider to query localized content items for sitemaps in OrchardCore CMS. It handles different content type filtering, localization considerations, and query execution.

classes.name: LocalizedContentItemsQueryProvider
classes.description: A class that provides localized content items for sitemaps, implementing query logic based on content type and localization.

methods.name: LocalizedContentItemsQueryProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for content item querying.

methods.name: GetContentItemsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves content items based on source criteria, handling localization and filtering, and populates the query context.
